item.title: Bulletin updated at 03:05 HKT 07/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will moderate in the next few days. Winds will be weak and the visibility will be relatively low over the coast of Guangdong. It will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas early next week, it will become cool and windier over the region.
